title: Surreal Eye Fusion
description: A surreal painted composition featuring a split human face with one golden crying eye and a large central red eye with a glowing spiral pupil. A vibrant green dog with intricate patterns and a dripping multicolored muzzle nuzzles the face from the right. The background contains cracked textures, floating symbols, and puzzle pieces.
prompt: Surreal symbolic painting of a split human face with golden tears merging into a large central red eye with hypnotic spiral pupil, a vibrant lime green dog with intricate line patterns nuzzling the face, colorful dripping paint from eyes and muzzle, cracked dark background with floating runes and puzzle pieces, dramatic lighting, textured brushwork, psychedelic color palette
